lines: I won't forget you — walking down the winding road
Crossing yellow sand with the newborn sun and a dream
Those days of tickling each other and tumbling down, never to return
Surely a future noisier than I imagined is waiting for me
Just from the sound of "I love you," I felt I could grow strong
Holding our small joys tight enough to crush them
With dirty hands I wrote out the feelings about to spill over
Even though I said I wanted that letter thrown away right away
A little sleepy, I pried it open with cold water
Now it passes me by, as if rushed along, as if swept away
Just from the sound of "I love you," I felt I could grow strong
Someday, in this place, I want to meet you again
However far I walk I can't arrive — cheeks wet with snow of the heart
Pretending to be a devil, I tore the song apart — turn it into petals dancing on the spring wind
I won't forget you — walking down the winding road
Surely a future noisier than I imagined is waiting for me
Just from the sound of "I love you," I felt I could grow strong
Holding our small joys tight enough to crush them
I felt I could go on living, whether by cheating or honestly
Someday, in this place, I want to meet you again
